notes: POC scope: deploy Redwood Private control plane and inference nodes inside Helios-managed AWS VPC using our Terraform modules and Helm charts. Validate chat + embeddings workloads and verify audit log export to their Splunk cluster.

Helios requirements summary: data residency US-only (must stay in us-east-1), SSO via SAML (Okta), SOC2 evidence requested, retention controls for logs (7 years for audit entries), and customer-managed KMS (CMEK) required for token-level encryption.

Security asks: SecOps wants a live demo showing KMS integration with a customer CMK and proof that Redis/KV cache is encrypted at rest. Also requested network flow diagram and list of open ports; legal wants explicit data-flow diagrams for PII scoping.

Tech details: we'll provide Terraform modules: redwood_vpc_peering.tf (peer to Helios transit), redwood_controlplane.tf (EKS + IAM roles), and helm values file with overrides for metrics, logging, and nodeGroup sizing. SE notes: use spine/leaf private subnets, enable endpoint interfaces for S3 and ECR.

Integration tests: automated post-deploy suite (pytest) that covers: 1) end-to-end chat generation (p95 latency < 80ms for single-turn baseline), 2) embeddings indexing + reranking correctness, 3) KV cache persistence across restarts, 4) audit log delivery and schema validation, 5) encrypted traffic verification and CMEK key rotation test.

Sign-off criteria (agreed): signed security attestation, successful POC run in Helios VPC with smoke + integration tests green, documented KMS policy and Splunk ingestion working, SLA/latency report and cost estimate accepted by Infra team.

Quotes/paraphrase: Helios SecOps lead said: 'We need to see the CMK in action and confirm no customer data leaves us-east-1.' AE note: emphasize our fallback routing is disabled for Private deployments per Helios request.
Timeline expectation: 2-3 weeks for POC execution (customer engineers will run Terraform with our guidance), additional 2 weeks for legal/security sign-off depending on KMS policy edits.

Risk/mitigation: potential delay from Helios Legal on data residency clause — workaround is a limited-scope demo with synthetic data to expedite security verification. HSM request flagged as future phase if required by compliance.
Follow-ups: schedule walkthrough with Helios SRE for helm chart overrides; provide sample IAM least-privilege role JSON; share CI job for running integration tests against VPC deployment.
use_case_summary: Enterprise bank evaluating Redwood Private to run chat-based customer support and internal compliance assistants in a Helios-managed VPC. Primary goals: strict US data residency, KMS-managed keys, audit logging into Splunk, and predictable latency for customer-facing chat.
additional_commments: Helios prefers pull model for log collection into Splunk; plan to provide a Fluent Bit config in Helm values. Estimated POC resources: 2 SE days + 1 SRE day from customer per week.
